messages:
maria_engr: Heads-up — we're doing a mini-canary for the credentialed-routing change tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over ~40m with pause points at each step. smoke owner: @sophie_sre. Please ack if you can be available for the 09:00–10:00 UTC window.
kevin_relmgr: ack from me. can you share the cohort selection? are we geo-based or header-based?
maria_engr: cohort is header-based: users with header `X-Cred=beta` + fallback 1% random bucket for general traffic. geo excluded for first ramp (we want consistent latency sample).
sophie_sre: I'll be oncall. what are the smoke checks you want run? I can script them.
maria_engr: minimal smoke checklist: 1) health ping to /health (200 + latency < 200ms) 2) sample gen with prompt set `credentialed_smoke_v1` to verify tokens returned 3) rollout-specific telemetry: error rates & tail latency in last 5m. I'll paste quick commands below.
maria_engr: ```bash
# health
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://api.redwood.example/internal/health
# sample gen
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"cred-v1","input":"smoke test"}' | jq .
```
arnold_pm: can we add a manual pause at 5% to wait for 10m? product wants a quick sanity check before the 20% bump.
maria_engr: yes — pause schedule: after 5% wait 10m, then 20% -> monitor 15m, then proceed to full if no regressions. if any step breaches thresholds roll back to previous stable config.
sophie_sre: thresholds noted: errors > 0.5% OR p95 latency increase > 30% triggers rollback. I'll monitor infra alerts and run the smoke commands after each bump.
kevin_relmgr: who triggers the ramp? I'll run the rollout toggle and follow the doc. @maria_engr — can you confirm the toggle CLI?
maria_engr: use `deployctl rollout set --feature credentialed-routing --percent X --cohort header:X-Cred=beta` (we also have the UI toggle if you prefer). I'll be online for coordination.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: credentialed-routing canary start at 09:00 UTC (2419999999). Created rollout id rlt-cred-2419. See /deploys/rlt-cred-2419
kevin_relmgr: perfect. I'll start at 09:00 UTC and post updates in this thread.
arnold_pm: thx everyone — I'll watch metrics dashboards and ping if product flags anything. :thumbsup:
sophie_sre: quick note: I'll create a tinysynthetic traffic job to exercise auth paths 2m before first bump. will post results.
maria_engr: awesome. short checklist for tomorrow: 1) kevin triggers 1% at 09:00 2) sophie runs synthetic + health check 3) wait 5m, bump to 5% 4) hold 10m (manual) 5) bump to 20% if green 6) monitor, then continue. rollback plan in /runbooks/canary/credentialed-routing.md
kevin_relmgr: ack. thanks — will update with rlt-cred-2419 timestamps and smoke outputs here.
maria_engr: thanks team :rocket:
